dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「はあ……面白かったねえ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Okay, let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「途中、どうなるかと思ったけど……ラスト、
　ハッピーエンドになって良かったよな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、浮気した恋人を、あんな簡単に許すも
　のなのかな……私だったら、ぶっ飛ばすけど」
dialogues.en:
From what I hear listening to the rehearsals, I guess you
guys will do fine.
dialogues.text:
From what I hear listening to the rehearsals, I guess you
guys will do fine.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、そこはほら、お話だし。最後はやっぱ、
　丸く収まった方がいいだろ」
dialogues.en:
"But you may have some problems during the love confession
time after the graduation ceremony."
dialogues.text:
"But you may have some problems during the love confession
time after the graduation ceremony."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね」
dialogues.en:
I guess there is really very little chance that boys will
tell her that they like her. Because the word about her
relationship with me has already spread...
dialogues.text:
I guess there is really very little chance that boys will
tell her that they like her. Because the word about her
relationship with me has already spread...

dialogues.jp:
俺はちらっと振り返り、映画館から吐き出され
る人の群れに目をやった。
dialogues.en: "She'll find out about it soon."
dialogues.text: "She'll find out about it soon."

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、見ろよ。カップルばっかり」
dialogues.en:
It's only a matter of time. But whether the girl is gonna
give up on Mako is another matter.
dialogues.text:
It's only a matter of time. But whether the girl is gonna
give up on Mako is another matter.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、恋愛映画を、同性の友達と行っても、
　あまり面白くないかもね」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、何か、やたらと身体を密着させている
　な……うお、あいつらなんて、人の流れの真
　ん中でキスしてやがる。邪魔くさ……」
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じろじろ見ちゃ悪いよ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing, never mind."
dialogues.text: "Nothing, never mind."

dialogues.jp:
くいくいと服を引っ張られ、俺は身体を前に向
けた。
dialogues.en:
She waves her hand in front of her face as if she was trying
to gloss over what she was going to say.
dialogues.text:
She waves her hand in front of her face as if she was trying
to gloss over what she was going to say.

dialogues.jp:
「やっぱ、ああいうのって、映画に影響されて
　るんだろうな」
dialogues.en:
And we walk down the stairs. The entrance to the middle
school building is some distance from this music room in the
special school building.
dialogues.text:
And we walk down the stairs. The entrance to the middle
school building is some distance from this music room in the
special school building.

dialogues.jp: ――ぴと
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりが、俺の腕を包むようにして、身体をぴ
たりとくっつけてくる。
dialogues.en:
Taking out her outdoor shoes from the shoe locker, Mako
exclaims in surprise.
dialogues.text:
Taking out her outdoor shoes from the shoe locker, Mako
exclaims in surprise.

dialogues.jp: 「……ことりも、影響受けた？」
dialogues.en: Mako's holding a white envelope in her hand.
dialogues.text: Mako's holding a white envelope in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……たまにはいいよね。映画も」
dialogues.en: "Is that a love letter from the girl?"
dialogues.text: "Is that a love letter from the girl?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうだな」

４月に入っていた。空気はすっかりぬるくなっ
て、正真正銘の春が到来していた。
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to read it for you?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to read it for you?"

dialogues.jp:
短いようで、やっぱり短かった春休みも、あと
もう少しで終わってしまう……。
dialogues.en: Looking at her anxious face, I naturally uttered such words.
dialogues.text: Looking at her anxious face, I naturally uttered such words.

dialogues.jp: 「明後日から、また学園生活が始まるな」
dialogues.en:
Saying a dutiful thing like she said before, she opens the
envelope and starts to read the letter.
dialogues.text:
Saying a dutiful thing like she said before, she opens the
envelope and starts to read the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん……同じクラスになれるといいね」
dialogues.en:
Mako's face is turning to a delighted expression in front of
me, as I watch her with breathless interest.
dialogues.text:
Mako's face is turning to a delighted expression in front of
me, as I watch her with breathless interest.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はは。暦先生に袖の下でも渡してみようか」
dialogues.en: "What does she say?"
dialogues.text: "What does she say?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それもいいけど……もう遅いと思うな」
dialogues.en:
From Mako's expression, I can guess that it's not something
bad.
dialogues.text:
From Mako's expression, I can guess that it's not something
bad.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いいんかい。優等生のことりさんともあろう
　人が」
dialogues.en: "Listen, Asakura. She says that she's gonna give up on me!"
dialogues.text: "Listen, Asakura. She says that she's gonna give up on me!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「違うよ、私は優等生なんかじゃなくって、好
　きな人と一緒にいたいって思う普通の女の子」
dialogues.en:
Coming close to my side as if she's going to hug me, she
shows me the letter.
dialogues.text:
Coming close to my side as if she's going to hug me, she
shows me the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だから……、今までみたいには、一緒に居ら
　れなくなるんだなって思うと……寂しいなっ
　て」
dialogues.en: "Wow, you did it!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, you did it!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「休みの間は、たくさん会って……たくさんお
　話して……」
dialogues.en:
Hey, you told me that you are not supposed to show someone's
love letter to other people, didn't you?
dialogues.text:
Hey, you told me that you are not supposed to show someone's
love letter to other people, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「楽しいこともそうじゃないこともあって……」
dialogues.en:
I was going to avert my eyes from the letter, but I spotted
one sentence.
dialogues.text:
I was going to avert my eyes from the letter, but I spotted
one sentence.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな……」
dialogues.en: "'I hope you'll be very happy together'......"
dialogues.text: "'I hope you'll be very happy together'......"

dialogues.jp:
今から思えば……何であの時工藤に嫉妬したん
だか。
dialogues.en: What can I do even if she says so......?
dialogues.text: What can I do even if she says so......?

dialogues.jp: 俺はことりが好きで。
dialogues.en: "Well, it's a good outcome for you."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's a good outcome for you."

dialogues.jp: ことりも俺が好きだってわかってるのに。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you may be right."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you may be right."

dialogues.jp:
（ま、初めてのヤキモチってことで加減がわか
　らなかった、と）
dialogues.en:
I had got a negative image of the girl, but she sounds like
she's a gentle and good girl.
dialogues.text:
I had got a negative image of the girl, but she sounds like
she's a gentle and good girl.

dialogues.jp: 自分勝手に結論づけて苦笑する。
dialogues.en:
"Phew... Anyway, I guess I don't have to continue pretending
to be your boyfriend."
dialogues.text:
"Phew... Anyway, I guess I don't have to continue pretending
to be your boyfriend."

dialogues.jp: と。
dialogues.en: "What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "What's the matter?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりが一層身体をきゅっと引きつけてくる。
まるで、体温さえも記憶に刻もうとするように。
dialogues.en: She falters, her face clouding over.
dialogues.text: She falters, her face clouding over.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、学生さんに戻ったって、何が変わるわ
　けでもないけど」
dialogues.en: "Finally, from tomorrow I can rest."
dialogues.text: "Finally, from tomorrow I can rest."

dialogues.jp:
ことりが、頭を肩にちょこんと乗せてくる。変
わりはしない──そうは言っても、やはり物寂
しいのかもしれなかった。
dialogues.en: "What's that?"
dialogues.text: "What's that?"

dialogues.jp:
「はは、俺らも、やっぱ映画に影響されたカッ
　プルって感じだな」
dialogues.en: "You think so?"
dialogues.text: "You think so?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「くす。そうだね」
dialogues.en: "Of course."
dialogues.text: "Of course."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en:
"There are only two days left, so I think it'll be okay to
tell them that I have something else to do..."
dialogues.text:
"There are only two days left, so I think it'll be okay to
tell them that I have something else to do..."

dialogues.jp:
明後日から学園。やっぱり、休みの間のように
は、頻繁に会ったり出来ないだろうな……。
dialogues.en:
Even if someone says that I'm skipping out on the work, I
can get away with it.
dialogues.text:
Even if someone says that I'm skipping out on the work, I
can get away with it.

dialogues.jp:
俺はことりの細い肩に手をかけると、抱き寄せ
た。
dialogues.en:
I don't know why, but she doesn't turn her eyes away from
me.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why, but she doesn't turn her eyes away from
me.

dialogues.jp:
驚くようなことりの声を無視して、ことりを俺
の胸に押しつける。
dialogues.en: "But it's a pain in the neck... And I'm bad at getting up."
dialogues.text: "But it's a pain in the neck... And I'm bad at getting up."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: I shrug with a sigh.
dialogues.text: I shrug with a sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こうした方が……もっと感じられるだろ」
dialogues.en: "I can still come if you let me show up late."
dialogues.text: "I can still come if you let me show up late."

dialogues.jp: 俺も。ことりも。

こうして抱き合えば、もっとずっと、お互いの
ことを感じられた。
dialogues.en: I was just joking to make her mad...
dialogues.text: I was just joking to make her mad...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん……朝倉君がドキドキしてるの、伝わっ
　てくるよ」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay? You're acting strange."
dialogues.text: "Are you okay? You're acting strange."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……何だか心が溶けちゃうみたいだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's nothing... Let's go."
dialogues.text: "It's nothing... Let's go."

dialogues.jp: 本当にとろけそうな声で、ことりが｛ささや／囁｝く。
dialogues.en: She shoves the letter into her pocket and changes her shoes.
dialogues.text: She shoves the letter into her pocket and changes her shoes.

dialogues.jp:
その熱い吐息が俺の胸に当たって、鼓動はもっ
と速くなって……。
dialogues.en: "Ah, hold on."
dialogues.text: "Ah, hold on."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「幸せすぎるね……」
dialogues.en:
I also get out my outdoor shoes from the shoe locker and
change my shoes, and run after her.
dialogues.text:
I also get out my outdoor shoes from the shoe locker and
change my shoes, and run after her.

dialogues.jp: 今、この瞬間。
世界には、俺とことりしか存在しなかった。
dialogues.en: We're walking side by side without talking to each other.
dialogues.text: We're walking side by side without talking to each other.

dialogues.jp: ◆世界に２人だけ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: デート帰り。
dialogues.en: "Um, yes."
dialogues.text: "Um, yes."

dialogues.jp:
ただ抱きしめ合うだけで、俺とことりは幸せに
なれた……。
dialogues.en:
I come out of the music room with Mako after she finishes
exchanging goodbyes with the other members.
dialogues.text:
I come out of the music room with Mako after she finishes
exchanging goodbyes with the other members.
